name: Sioux Falls Saturday 2023

venue.name: Peace Lutheran Church
venue.details: Follow signs from the main entrance to the Fellowship Hall

information:
This competition will be held alongside [Sioux City Sunday](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SiouxCitySunday2023) on the following day. You can compete in one or both of the competitions!

We also have two local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480/) and [Iowa Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1629559883761917/) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)
